task_description: Option A: add rich MANUAL call & WhatsApp activity logging to the lead detail page. Clicking Call/WhatsApp opens the dialer/WhatsApp and then prompts a small dialog to capture outcome (required), optional duration (call only), and optional notes, stored as a lead_activities row in the existing payload JSONB (no migration, no external API). Timeline updated to display call/whatsapp outcomes; other activity types unchanged.
